results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Choose creation path using HEYGEN_V2_VIDEO_GENERATE (avatar + script) or GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS (prompt-based alternative).
[Optional (if avatar_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Browse and pick an avatar using HEYGEN_V2_AVATARS (capture avatar_id).
[Optional (if voice_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Browse and pick a voice using HEYGEN_V2_VOICES (capture voice_id).
[Required (HeyGen path)] [Step]: Render the talking-avatar clip using HEYGEN_V2_VIDEO_GENERATE (script + avatar_id/voice_id; set resolution only if allowed).
[Required (HeyGen path)] [Next Step]: Poll until complete using HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS (collect final video URL/metadata and download promptly).
[Optional (if a public viewer link is needed)] [Next Step]: Create a share link using HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL.
[Fallback (if HeyGen fails with plan limits)] [Fallback]: If HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS returns error.code=RESOLUTION_NOT_ALLOWED, rerun HEYGEN_V2_VIDEO_GENERATE at a lower resolution.
[Required (Gemini path)] [Step]: Generate using GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS, then fetch the downloadable result using GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO (repeat wait if still pending or link expired).
known_pitfalls: [GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO] data.video_file.s3url is short-lived; download immediately or re-call GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO to refresh the link.
[GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS] 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT can occur when duration constraints don’t match the selected resolution.
[GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS] Invalid request can occur if person_generation is unsupported by the default model; use a compatible model setting.
[HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS] status=failed may include error.code=RESOLUTION_NOT_ALLOWED (plan restriction); regenerate at lower resolution.
[HEYGEN_V2_VIDEO_GENERATE] Can fail with 404 avatar_not_found or 400 invalid_parameter (voice not found); re-select IDs via HEYGEN_V2_AVATARS/HEYGEN_V2_VOICES.

HEYGEN_V2_VIDEO_GENERATE.description: Generates a customized video using Heygen's AI-driven platform. This endpoint allows you to create videos featuring digital avatars with specified voices, enabling dynamic content creation. It's ideal for producing personalized video content, such as explainer videos, product demonstrations, or interactive presentations. The endpoint supports multiple input configurations, allowing for complex video scenarios with different characters and voices. Use this when you need to programmatically create AI-generated videos with specific avatar and voice combinations. Note that while the endpoint offers extensive customization, real-time video generation is not supported, and processing times may vary based on complexity and system load.

type.description: Type of voice input (text or audio)

talking_photo_id.description: ID of the talking photo (for talking_photo type)

url.description: URL of the uploaded image/video resource. For image/video types, provide either 'url' or the corresponding asset_id (exactly one).

value.description: Hex color code for the background (e.g., '#FFFFFF'). Required when type is 'color'.

image_asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the uploaded image. For image type, provide either 'url' or 'image_asset_id' (exactly one).

video_asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the uploaded video. For video type, provide either 'url' or 'video_asset_id' (exactly one).

background.description:
Background configuration for video input. Supports color, image, or video backgrounds.

For color: Provide 'type' as 'color' and 'value' as hex color code (e.g., '#FFFFFF').
For image: Provide 'type' as 'image' and either 'url' or 'image_asset_id' (exactly one required).
For video: Provide 'type' as 'video' and either 'url' or 'video_asset_id' (exactly one required).

HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS.description: Tool to retrieve the current processing status and metadata for a specific video by ID. Use when you need to check video processing progress, get time-limited URLs for video downloads, or monitor video generation completion. Video rendering is asynchronous and typically takes 30–180+ seconds; poll at moderate intervals rather than tight loops. Verify returned URLs are accessible before surfacing to users. Note that returned URLs expire after 7 days but can be regenerated by calling this endpoint again.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video to retrieve status for. This ID is returned when a video is created via the video generation API.
